digest.component_or_area: reliability test oracles (subprocess and network sentinels)
propositions: Two reliability tests consume multi-second wall time per matrix cell due to production-scale real-time values: a 10-second low-speed window with 15-second loopback server and 1-second per-attempt timeout with real 2s/4s retry sleeps.

The snapshot fetch stall test must retain real loopback traffic above the configured floor for more than one complete window cycle but with an injected 1-second test window instead of production's 10-second window.

The ACLI subprocess timeout test must inject sub-second call/grace/drain values, record the exact logical retry schedule [2, 4] without sleeping, and verify every spawned PID is absent after terminal failure.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults must remain unchanged (byte-identical).
Both test modules must complete in low single-digit seconds without absolute upper-bound assertions or wall-clock pass thresholds.
